svg.text: File Home Insert Formulas Data Review View
Ribbon: buttons grouped by tab (Home → Number, Styles …)
File Edit View Insert Format Data Tools Extensions
Toolbar: undo, format, borders; everything else in the menus
• Name box: the address of the selected cell (B3)
• Formula bar: what the cell really contains
• Grid: columns are letters, rows are numbers
• Sheet tabs: one workbook (file) holds many sheets
The same workbook open in both apps: the grid, name box, formula bar, and sheet tabs work the same way
